newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - June 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Tianjin port city reports success in achieving rapid economic growth but low inflation rate since 1990.
- Survey shows 37.62 percent of people over 15 smoke in China
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH

- Li Ruihuan, chairman of Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, visits Germany says hopes cooperation and exchanges between German state of Brandenburg and China's provinces and cities will further develop.
- China plans to supervise the state of running of 1,000 key state-owned enterprises and to make results public.
- Sichuan province expects record summer grain harvest this year
PEOPLE'S DAILY OVERSEAS EDITION
- China to have 120,000 tonne benzene glut this year
FINANCIAL NEWS
- U.S. insurer helps China State Commission for Economic Restructuring to promote China's pension system
CHINA SECURITIES
- Editorial says central bank faces dilemma over interest rates
- Shanghai seen offsetting 5-6 billion yuan in bad debts from state firm bankruptcies in 1997
CHINA BUSINESS TIMES
- Price war erupts in Sichuan province in purchase of silk cocoons
- China drafting law on housing funds, which hit 39.3 billion yuan at end-1996
CHINA BUSINESS DAILY
- China to regulate chaotic liquor market to prevent fake liquor and tax evasion
BEIJING ECONOMIC DAILY
- Beijing industrial output up 16.8 percent in May year-on-year
CHINA DAILY
- China's National Environmental Protection Agency to select several cities as good environmental models
- Sino-Singapore joint venture to produce edible oils begins production in coastal Yantai city
